senses.gloss:
भृ भृ, i. 1, and ii. 3, बिभृ, Par. Ātm.
 1. To bear, to hold, Vikr. d. 140; Chr. 16, 17.
 2. To wear, Man. 6, 6.
 3. Ātm. To gain, Chr. 291, 13 = Rigv. i. 64, 13.
 4. To possess, MBh. 3, 2583; to have, 2, 57.
 5. To form, [] Rājat. 5, 332.
 6. To nourish, to maintain, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 5.
 7. i. 1, Ātm. To hire, Nal. 15, 4.
 8. To support, Man. 9, 95.
 9. To fill, Hit. 2, 34.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भृत.
 1. Hired.
 2. Having, being possessed of.
 3. Filled. m. A servant.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अतिभृत (rather भृत with अति),
 1. Carefully protected.
 2. Filled, Kir. 5, 20.
 --With आ आ, To bring near, to bestow, Lass. 99, 2 = Rigv. v. 9, 7.
 --With नि नि, निभृत,
 1. Modest, humble; ˚तम्, humbly, Pañc. 162, 24.
 2. Unmoved, Śāk. d. 8.
 3. Hidden, Pañc. 46, 13; 193, 7.
 4. ˚तम् adv. Hidden, Pañc. 105, 4; secretly, Man. 9, 263.
 5. ˚तम्, adv. with वि-धा, To make hidden, to shut, Pañc. 186, 8.
 6. Lonely, solitary, Megh. 83; ˚तम् with कृ, To dismiss all but one, Hit. 56, 19.
 --Comp.
 --With प्र प्र, To offer, Chr. 291, 1.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To bring together, Rām. 1, 11, 13.
 2. To accomplish, Vikr. 85, 17; d. 157.
 3. To nourish, Rām. 1, 52, 8. संभृत,
 1. Collected, all, Vikr. d. 38.
 2. Gained, got.
 3. Composed, Hit. iv. d. 68.
 4. Filled.
 5. Nourished, Hit. iii. d. 125 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3272).
 6. Brought, put, Megh. 44.
 --Cf. ϕέρω, ϕόρτος, ϕορμός, ϕωριαμός, ϕάρετρα, ϕᾶρος, δί-ϕρος, δι-ϕθέρα; Lat. fero; Goth. bairan; A.S. beran; Goth. barms; A.S. bearm; Goth. barn; A.S. bearn; byrdhen; Goth. briggan; A.S. bringan.

† भॄ भॄ, ii. 9, भृणा, भृणी, Par.
 1. To blame.
 2. To bear (cf. भृ).
 3. To fry.
 4. To bend, to be crooked.
